answer: Use rotating audit credits backed by scarce ledger escrow. 1) A newcomer locks 80 POA for 30 days and gets only one seat per verified payout key. 2) A public beacon picks three fresh, random task samples; two established peers replay them and sign independent scores. 3) Matching fingerprints or shared withdrawal keys merge accounts and slash 40 POA. Faking 1,000 seats ties up 80,000 POA for a month, risks 40,000 POA, and needs 3,000 independent peer reviews over 30 days. Like an island mirrored in a canyon, a nectar trail exposes one source behind many names.
